mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Zombie Ward bonus damage</titleLeft><mainText>Your next attack or offensive spell against an enemy Champion will deal bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLongDescLocalizationKey:
Takedowns on enemy Wards cause friendly Zombie Wards to sprout from their corpses. Zombie Wards are visible, last for @WardDuration@s and do not count towards your ward limit.

Gain an adaptive bonus of @AdaptiveForce.-1*0.6@ Attack Damage or @AdaptiveForce@ Ability Power for every Zombie Ward spawned, up to @MaxStacks@. After spawning @MaxStacks@ Zombie Wards, additionally gain @CompletionBonus@ adaptive force.
mShortDescLocalizationKey: <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Takedown'>Takedowns</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> on enemy Wards cause friendly Zombie Wards to sprout from their corpses. Gain permanent AD or AP, <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'>adaptive</lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> for each Zombie Ward spawned plus a bonus upon completion.
